usage: agentware audit [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--with-tests] [--stale]
                       [--max-age-days MAX_AGE_DAYS] [--propose]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --with-tests          also run the unittest suite (tests/) and fail the
                        audit on failure
  --stale               report aged volatile entries + near-duplicate/conflict
                        pairs (advisory)
  --max-age-days MAX_AGE_DAYS
                        staleness window in days for --stale (default: 120)
  --propose             with --stale: emit ONE tier-2 PROPOSED review
                        workorder (a draft work/auto/<slug>/plan.md) for the
                        stale/superseded/conflict findings — never mutates the
                        KB/index, never auto-marks or decrements trust; a
                        clean report proposes nothing
